title: Wim
description: Obsessed with stories of heroes and the brave acts of the Jedi, Wim wanted to be a hero, going on adventures and fighting for good. Growing up on At Attin, it didn't seem like Wim would ever get a chance for real adventures like the Jedi of old, but one day he found what he thought was an old Jedi Temple that turned out to be a starship and his life changed forever.
